ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
ContextThreadId
UTID of thread originating this event
TreeId
If this event is part of a detection tree, the tree ID it is part of.
TargetProcessId
The unique ID of a target process (in decimal, non-hex format). This field exists in almost all events, and it
represents the ID of the process that is responsible for the activity of the event in focus. For example, the
TargetProcessId of a process that performed thread injection in an InjectedThread event
TargetThreadId
The primary thread associated with this service.
RawProcessId
The operating system’s internal PID. For matching, use the UPID fields which guarantee a unique process
identifier
RawThreadId
The operating system’s internal PID. For matching, use the UPID fields which guarantee a unique process
identifier
